scope: One fresh source-bound comparison of the frozen base Qwen checkpoint and existing twenty-update LoRA candidate. Offline inference only; no new training, reserved outcomes or trading.

conclusion.structured_output: The adapter produced valid forecasts on all forty cases under the fixed strict contract. Base Qwen reached the forty-eight-token limit on every case and had no valid completed forecast under this protocol.
conclusion.directional_discrimination: The adapter returned neither_positive at all three cost settings on every case, exactly matching the no-opportunity and training-joint-mode controls.
conclusion.interpretation: This is format/prior-level diagnostic evidence, not evidence of a predictive or profitable trading strategy. Apparent accuracy comes entirely from the no-opportunity class frequency in this sample.
conclusion.promotion_decision: Keep the adapter quarantined. Do not connect it to paper or live execution.
conclusion.base_comparison_limit: Base invalid outputs are protocol failures, not no-opportunity predictions or proof that the underlying base model has no financial knowledge. No decoder, prompt or token-budget rescue was attempted.

protocol.exposure: Already-exposed 2025 development; NOT an independent holdout
protocol.selection: The same fixed even-rank indices, case IDs and original prompts as the preserved failed attempt; no label-based reselection or successful-subset processing
protocol.native_model_input: Feature-only original causal prompt, case ID and input hash. No dataset path, completion, target hash, date, role, contract or future values in the worker selection.
protocol.decoding: Greedy CUDA BF16, seed 42, one beam, eager attention, cache enabled; no chat template or constrained decoder
protocol.output_contract: Terminal EOS and exactly one JSON object with the three specified cost keys, allowed classes and cost monotonicity; no output repair
protocol.invalid_scoring: Invalid forecasts remain separate and count as incorrect in overall accuracy; they are never converted to no-opportunity

extra_4_ticks.support_warning: Only neither_positive is supported at this cost. Perfect accuracy/F1 here cannot demonstrate directional skill.

limitations: Forty supervised cases across thirty-nine sessions are a small, imbalanced diagnostic sample from already-exposed development, not independent evidence.
Labels are conditioned on future observability. Unavailable/uncertain rows were not treated as negative examples, so selection can bias comparisons.
The candidate has only twenty training updates on twenty examples out of 19,678 training examples; this is not a full training run.
No-opportunity collapse is observed, but its mechanism is not established. This batch does not prove which features, loss weights or longer training would improve it.
Inputs contain thirty-seven causal snapshot features, not a temporal LOB encoder or proven full-market state representation.

Targets describe delayed-entry fifteen-second 6E futures quote opportunities with crossed quotes and extra round-trip tick costs. They are not cTrader EURUSD CFD fills, broker PnL, causal explanations or confirmed iceberg events.
Call duration includes initialization and sequential bounded diagnostics; it is not a production decision-latency benchmark.
The nested cost settings share the same cases. Missed directional counts across costs must not be summed as distinct trades.
next: Preregister a larger train-only experiment with a fixed compute budget, training-only class-balance diagnostics and inexpensive feature-classifier controls. Freeze the sampling or weighting policy before fitting; do not select examples by validation outcomes.
Retain no-opportunity controls, invalid-output reporting and class-specific directional metrics. Do not use headline accuracy as evidence of improvement.
Keep the separately reserved 2026 validation, test and lockbox outcomes out of development tuning. Independent evaluation requires its own frozen protocol and authority.

Require directional discrimination, realistic execution economics and broker-specific paper evidence before any model deployment. Do not start another training or inference batch automatically from this report.
